entities.summary: Song Minsoon (b. 1948-07-28, South Gyeongsang) was a explorer or navigator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in South Gyeongsang and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, political leaders, asia.
